title: MFP Source GO Annotation
description: Relational model for source-explicit Gene Ontology annotations under scheme MFPB_SOURCE_GO_ANNOTATION_V1. Preserves source annotations structurally without inferring function-compartment links or contextual triplets.

annotation_id.description: Deterministic unique annotation identifier under scheme MFPB_SOURCE_GO_ANNOTATION_V1.

protein_id.description: Entity identifier in mfp_proteins.csv under scheme MFPB_PROTEIN_ID_V1.

source_id.description: Canonical source identifier from source catalog.

source_record_id.description: Source-local record identifier linking to mfp_source_records.csv.

claim_id.description: Optional foreign key linking to a discrete claim in functional_claims.schema.json, or null if the annotation has no linked text statement.

source_field.description: Source-native field name from which this annotation was extracted (e.g. 'GO', 'GO_Moon').

annotation_index.description: Zero-based occurrence index of this annotation within the source field/record.

raw_annotation_text.description: Exact verbatim raw text line or fragment from which the annotation was parsed.

go_aspect.description: Source-declared Gene Ontology aspect (BP, MF, CC, or unassigned), or null if not indicated.

term_name.description: Source-declared term label or description, when explicitly provided in the raw line, or null.

evidence_raw.description: Original evidence string explicitly provided in the raw line (e.g. 'IEA:UniProtKB-KW', 'IDA:HPA'), or null if absent. No empty strings or inferred metadata.

annotation_status.description: Explicit parse and review status of the source annotation.

notes.description: Optional technical notes or parsing caveats, or null.
